subject: Alberta Indigenous Patient Safety Investigator and Advocate
research_question: What privacy-protecting public evidence exists about the activity, outputs and outcomes of Alberta's Indigenous Patient Safety Investigator and Advocate?
summary: One role-specific aggregate activity measure was located: Alberta's 2026–29 Primary and Preventative Health Services business plan reports 321 correspondence items in 2025. The measure does not identify unique complainants, accepted matters, completed reviews, recommendations, referrals, resolutions or outcomes. Parent-office reporting describes broader activity and process changes, but it cannot be attributed to this role unless the source separates it.

expected_fields.public_finding: The role-specific business-plan measure reports 321 correspondence items in 2025. Correspondence volume is an activity measure, not a count of complaints, people, accepted cases or outcomes.

sources_checked.title: Primary and Preventative Health Services Business Plan 2026–29

expected_fields.public_finding: No role-specific count of matters accepted for review or investigation was located in the official sources searched.

expected_fields.public_finding: No role-specific count of completed Health Charter reviews or other investigations was located.

Indigenous Patient Safety Investigator and Advocate

expected_fields.public_finding: Parent-office reporting describes standardized follow-up protocols and information-sharing improvements across Alberta's advocate offices. The annual report does not attribute those changes to the Indigenous Patient Safety Investigator and Advocate.

A role-specific correspondence metric appears in the 2026–29 ministry business plan, and the parent ministry annual report confirms the appointment. No comprehensive role-specific annual report or outcome ledger was located.

sources_checked.title: Primary and Preventative Health Services Business Plan 2026–29

expected_fields.public_finding: The public record supports appointment, operation and community-facing education. It does not provide role-specific aggregate follow-up on recommendations, resolutions or resulting system changes.

sources_checked.title: Indigenous Patient Safety Investigator and Advocate learning session

indigenous_led_assessment.finding: Siksika Health Services documented the 2023 announcement, and the First Nations Telehealth Network hosted a 2026 public learning session about access and process. No independent Indigenous-led public evaluation of trust, accessibility, independence, effectiveness or outcomes was located in this bounded review.
indigenous_led_assessment.caution: Absence of a located evaluation does not establish support, opposition or lack of community awareness.

stopping_reason: The role page, complaint-process pages, advocate-office resource library, ministry business plans and annual reports, Hansard, and identified First Nations-serving public materials were checked. Additional searches were returning the same mandate and launch material; the remaining role-specific outcome detail appears non-public or requires direct records access.
next_bounded_action: Prepare, but do not send, a narrow information-request concept for privacy-protecting aggregate statistics and recommendation follow-up records.

information_request_concept.likely_record_holder: Ministry of Primary and Preventative Health Services / Office of Alberta Health Advocates
information_request_concept.missing_information: Aggregate counts of contacts and unique matters where maintained; accepted, declined or referred matters; completed reviews; recommendations issued; aggregate issue categories; resolutions; and non-identifying follow-up status.
suggested_record_categories: role-specific performance dashboards or annual summaries
information_request_concept.privacy_boundary: Request aggregate statistics only, with small-cell suppression where needed. Do not request complaint narratives, patient identities or medical information.
